page.overview:
Who is Daniel Kon?

Daniel Kon was a major antagonist in the Jurassic Park franchise, serving as the main antagonist of the Netflix series Jurassic World: Camp Cretaceous and a minor character in Jurassic World: Chaos Theory.

In Camp Cretaceous, he served as the unseen overarching antagonist of Season 1, one of the two overarching antagonists of Season 2 (alongside Henry Wu), one of the two overarching antagonists and additionally a cameo antagonist of Season 3, the overarching antagonist of Season 4, and the main antagonist of Season 5. In Chaos Theory, he served as a minor character of Season 1 and a posthumous character of Season 2.

He was the father of Kenji Kon and former President of Mantah Corp. After going to prison for 5 years, he lived in a halfway house for a year. He eventually sacrificed himself to save his son’s life before being killed by the Atrociraptor pack.

Daniel is Kenji's father but barely spends time with his son, much to the sadness of the latter. After the fall of Jurassic World, Daniel became the President of Mantah Corp according to his own words, but later mentions and reveals that he gave his former employee Kash D. Langford the order to blackmail the family of Sammy Gutierrez, which happened before the fall of Jurassic World. This probably means that Daniel has been president of Mantah Corp for a much longer period of time than assumed without telling his son, or for that matter, anyone else.
